sections.title: Composer modes
sections.markdown:
- **Simple** keeps routine writing, draft, and publish actions visible.
- **Focused** adds common publishing controls.
- **Full** exposes advanced metadata, SEO, and plugin fields.

All modes use the same content and save behavior. Switching modes does not clear hidden settings.

sections.title: Write, Preview, and Options
sections.markdown:
- **Write** contains the title, content type, publishing status, and Markdown source.
- **Preview** uses the same render pipeline as the public site.
- **Options** contains common publishing metadata. Full mode also exposes advanced fields, SEO, and plugin controls.

sections.title: Save actions
sections.markdown:
- **Save draft** keeps a private working copy for the current item.
- **Save** writes the real content item using the selected status.
- **Duplicate** starts a new copy from the current content.
- **History** opens revision snapshots for the current saved item.
- Revisions are created by real saves, not by draft save or autosave.
- Use **Content** to browse unrelated saved items and drafts.

sections.title: Slugs and duplicates
sections.markdown:
- A new title can suggest a slug while you are creating content.
- Duplicate slugs are checked before save.
- If a saved item already has an active draft, the composer warns you before you continue.

sections.title: Links, tags, emoji, and smileys
sections.markdown: The toolbar inserts common Markdown and opens the link and emoji pickers. Tags are entered in **Options**. Type `:` to autocomplete emoji shortcodes. Open **Markdown reference** for supported syntax.
